name: Volkov-Saito Precision VS-R8 'Verdict'
description:
The Volkov-Saito VS-R8 is an eight-shot double-action revolver chambered in .357 Magnum, featuring a precision-machined stainless steel frame, adjustable target sights, and a competition-grade trigger that can be set for either double-action or cocked single-action fire. The eight-round cylinder — two more than standard — gives the Verdict a meaningful capacity advantage over conventional six-shot magnums.

The extra two rounds required significant engineering. The cylinder is wider than standard, which widens the frame, which changes the grip geometry. Volkov-Saito solved this with a proprietary ergonomic grip that fills the gap between the wider frame and the shooter's hand, producing a hold that is actually more comfortable than many six-shot revolvers despite the larger cylinder. The trigger reach in double-action is slightly longer, but the mechanical advantage is such that the pull weight remains manageable.

The Verdict occupies a premium position in the revolver market — it is the weapon for shooters who want revolver simplicity with capacity approaching semi-automatic pistols. In competitive revolver divisions, it dominates. In the field, the additional two rounds have tipped engagements in favor of its carriers enough times that the weapon's reputation is built on real results rather than marketing claims.
specifications:
caliber: .357 Magnum
effective_range: 55 meters
rate_of_fire: Double-action / single-action revolver
magazine_capacity: 8 rounds (cylinder)
weight: 1.12 kg
tactical_use: A premium revolver offering eight-round .357 Magnum capacity with precision accuracy. The adjustable sights and competition trigger enable accurate fire at distances that challenge most revolvers. The additional two rounds extend engagement capability before reload. Best suited for experienced shooters who can exploit the weapon's accuracy advantage.
cultural_context: The Verdict is the revolver for people who have transcended the revolver-vs-semi-auto debate and simply want the best wheel gun available. In competitive circles, it has forced rule changes in divisions that weren't designed for eight-shot revolvers. Among professionals, it signals expertise and investment in the revolver platform.
story_hooks: A Verdict with a ninth chamber — machined by hand into the cylinder — appears at a crime scene. The modification should be impossible without the cylinder exploding, but the weapon has clearly been fired.
Volkov-Saito announces a smart-linked Verdict with BCI integration, and the revolver purist community fractures over whether technology has any place in a wheel gun.

physical_description.visual_profile: A substantial, purposeful revolver with a distinctly wider frame than conventional magnums. The eight-round cylinder creates a noticeably bulbous profile, but the overall silhouette remains balanced and professional rather than blocky. The longer sight radius and adjustable rear sight give it a target-pistol aesthetic despite its revolver form.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length 254mm, cylinder width 52mm (notably wider than standard), frame width 38mm, barrel length 127mm (4-inch standard configuration)
physical_description.weight_description: Substantial but well-balanced — 1.12kg settles naturally in the hand with no muzzle flip. Dense enough to feel engineered rather than hastily assembled, yet not punishing for extended shooting
physical_description.primary_material: Precision-machined stainless steel frame and cylinder, creating a durable, corrosion-resistant foundation. Suggests durability in GLMZ's industrial environments without requiring constant maintenance
physical_description.finish: Brushed stainless steel with mirror-polished cylinder — the contrast between matte frame and reflective cylinder emphasizes the engineering precision. No cosmetic chrome; this is functional finish
physical_description.color_scheme: Silver-gray stainless steel primary with darker steel trigger and hammer. Minimal visual noise — the weapon speaks through geometry rather than decoration
physical_description.grip_texture: Proprietary ergonomic polymer grip with subtle textured surface — slightly stippled for positive purchase without being aggressive. Wraparound design that fills the gap created by the wider frame, creating an intuitive hold despite the non-standard geometry
distinctive_features: Eight-round cylinder — visibly wider and longer than standard revolver cylinders, creating distinctive bulge in the cylinder area
Adjustable target-style rear sight mounted on top strap — two-dot configuration with fine windage/elevation adjustment screws
Ramp front sight with contrasting white outline — competition-grade visibility
Recessed ejector rod head flush with cylinder face — clean engineering detail
Fluted cylinder walls — both aesthetic and weight-saving, revealing precision machining
Competition trigger with crisp edges and polished face
Visible timing marks on cylinder underside where it aligns with frame
Minimal external hammer spur with clean geometry
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VOLKOV-SAITO PRECISION engraved on left frame in sans-serif font, MODEL VS-R8 'VERDICT' on barrel with serial number on frame below cylinder axis. Subtle certification marks indicate enhanced registration compliance for Tier 3+ legality
physical_description.condition_typical: Usually found in well-maintained condition — this is a precision instrument owned by shooters who respect it. Minimal wear on grip, possible light holster marks on frame from professional carry, occasional burn marks on cylinder from repeated .357 mag cycling
